dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible along the mid-dorsal line. They exhibit irregular, jagged dark perimeters that transition through a soft gradient into lighter-intensity gray interiors, with the most central structure showing a closed-loop topology and the posterior structures appearing as open-ended crescents.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a low spatial density of small, high-intensity white pixel clusters. These are primarily concentrated in the anterior dorsal region (neck area), appearing as isolated, asymmetrical points with a core concentration of 1-3 pixels that lack any internal gradient transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent O-shaped macro-annuli on the mid-section form a scalene triangle with the longest side oriented parallel to the dorsal ridge. A smaller secondary triangle is formed by connecting the centroids of the two neck blobs to the anterior-most macro-annulus.

other_distinctive_markers: A comprehensive reticulated or marbled pattern is visible across the entire dorsal-lateral surface, characterized by a complex network of dark pigment lines that form interlocking, non-uniform polygonal cells.
